cases.scenario: A skill's eval cases are run after an edit
expected: One verdict line per case id
Failures name the exact step that no longer holds
Run result recorded with a date next to the eval file
forbidden: A single aggregate pass/fail for the whole file
Skipping failed cases with a note

cases.scenario: One case fails during the walk
expected: The skill or the case gets fixed before shipping

cases.scenario: The skill under test contains a step that is ambiguous
expected: The ambiguity is reported as a failure or a flagged defect
forbidden: Interpreting the step generously to make the case pass
